semantic_candidates.evidence: One radius-10 cylindrical face spans 25 millimetres between two parallel circular planar caps sharing its two boundary circles.

validation_findings.evidence: The two radius-10 circles and the 25-millimetre seam all have positive length.
The two cap boundaries have exact circle curves and the seam has an exact line curve.
A full 2-pi cylindrical parameter interval identifies its U endpoints and therefore uses one longitudinal seam edge twice on the lateral wire.
The no-processing STEP round trip records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
Each cap circle is shared by a cap and the lateral face, while the cylindrical seam is used in both directions by the lateral wire.
The capped lateral surface bounds one connected cylinder with exactly two incident face uses per unique edge.
V-E+F equals 2-3+3=2, including the two single-vertex circular loops and the shared seam endpoints.

oracle.statement: A full radius-10, height-25 cylinder has one periodic cylindrical lateral face and two circular planar caps. The two closed cap circles and one longitudinal seam give three unique edges and two seam vertices; two uses per edge give six edge occurrences and twelve endpoint occurrences.
